cards.text: The word of the LORD comes to Ezekiel, a priest living in the land of the Chaldeans (Ezekiel 1:3). God calls him "Son of man" and opens with a question about the wood of the vine. The God who made the stars wants to talk about WOOD, so pull up a stool, friend, because this is going somewhere.

cards.question: God asks Ezekiel how the wood of the vine measures up against something else. Against what?

answers.text: Any branch of the forest trees

cards.text: Then God gets practical. Can wood from the vine be made into anything useful, even the smallest, simplest job a piece of wood could ever do?

cards.question: God asks if vine wood can even be made into a ___ to hang utensils on.
Vine wood can't be made into anything useful. So what does God say happens to it?

answers.text: It is cast into the fire for fuel
It is carved into a walking staff
It is left to rot in the field

cards.text: The fire devours both ends and chars the middle, and God asks if it can be useful for anything now. Friend, that's my first batch the day the oven timer quit: ends GONE, middle black, and me still standing there trying to stamp it like it was going in a box.

cards.question: True or false: God says that even when the vine wood was whole, before any fire touched it, it still couldn't be made useful.

cards.text: Then it turns. All that vine wood talk? That was the setup, because now comes "Therefore this is what the Lord GOD says:"

cards.question: Like the vine wood He has given to the fire for fuel, God says He will give up a people. Which people?

cards.text: God says He will set His face against them. Not a glance, friend, His FACE, and I think the next line is the hardest one in this whole message.

cards.question: True or false: God says the people of Jerusalem who have escaped the fire are safe for good.
When God sets His face against the people of Jerusalem, what does He tell Ezekiel will be known?

answers.text: That the vine will grow back

cards.text: Last line of the message. God says He will make the land desolate, and this time He tells Ezekiel exactly why.

cards.question: God says He will make the land desolate because the people have acted ___.
